title: a turn on a person
line: the queue names the home person's own unconfirmed parents first; a turn runs every runnable step once, keeps going past a source that did not answer, pauses on the assisted fetch list with its state beside the database naming that source; a step logged error stays runnable and a none run after it closes the step; resumed, the state is cleared, the report still names the source under left, and an unrelated page saved into the inbox is read for its identity and left there

steps.say: the queue names the home person's own parents first, the file's claim not yet accepted

expect.why: nobody has been planned into settledness yet, so nobody is passed over

steps.say: a great-great-grandmother's six key facts decided on the file's claims, so her plan opens searches
a turn on her, the network standing in: the first source does not answer, the rest answer nothing

fake_run.error: the harness's stand-in for no answer: timed out

expect.why: the plan opens at least one auto search step once her baseline is reviewed
the turn ran every one of her runnable steps once each

the runs that did not answer are logged as run_step.run reports them, each under its connector's own source: loc.gov and the Archive's newspapers on her obituary step, first in her plan since nobody has accepted her parents
her cemetery step, the next: one none run under the gravesite locator
the turn paused on her assisted fetch list, its state naming each source that did not answer, by the registry's name, with what it said
the step whose latest run is an error is still runnable: the source did not answer
a step logged none on these fields is not runnable
she still has an assisted fetch step waiting: what the turn paused on

steps.say: loc.gov answers on the second ask: a none run on the same fields under its own source; the Archive's newspapers have still not answered, so the step stays runnable

log.note: harness: the source answered on the second ask

expect.why: each source is read on its own: H07's error still leaves the step to ask

steps.say: the Archive's newspapers answer too: a none run under each source closes the step (one under the holder alone would not)

log.note: harness: the source answered on the second ask

steps.say: resumed after the browser session, an unrelated page saved into the inbox by hand

expect.why: the state file is cleared once a turn is resumed

has: the next turn asks it again

expect.why: the resumed turn's report still names the source that did not answer, under left, so the next turn asks it again
the unrelated page is read for its identity and left: it fulfils none of her steps
the unmatched file stays in the inbox, not filed under the tree

steps.say: the plan the turn itself regenerated is already settled
